## Checklist

- [ ] I used the existing advisory ID only when this is the same vulnerability.
- [ ] I created a new advisory for a different vulnerability.
- [ ] Exact releases are listed; I did not infer a range from one release.
- [ ] Each changed release has its own version_details statement.
- [ ] References support the claims made.
- [ ] Intent is left undetermined unless directly established by a reliable source.
- [ ] Review status remains PENDING; a maintainer must approve the change.
- [ ] I did not include API keys, secrets, or private data.
